import io,sys
path='src/courses/data/haunted-mansion.ts'
old="  teleporter,\n  wall,\n  water,\n} from './layoutKit';"
new="  teleporter,\n  v,\n  wall,\n  water,\n} from './layoutKit';"
src=io.open(path,encoding='utf-8').read()
if src.count(old)!=1: sys.exit('anchor not unique')
io.open(path,'w',encoding='utf-8').write(src.replace(old,new))
print('patched',path)
PY
